evidence.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Daisy Chain Fields Festival donates $20 million to nonprofits for women and girls

occurrences.checkable_against: National Domestic Workers Alliance policy and workforce demographic records
occurrences.quote_span: Her organization works to ensure federal workplace protections for domestic workers, who are disproportionately women and immigrant women.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or Ai-jen Poo's statement
occurrences.quote_span: National Domestic Workers Alliance President Ai-jen Poo said the festival’s joyful atmosphere serves as a “powerful reminder to women everywhere of all ages that, no matter what, we have each other.”
occurrences.speaker: Ai-jen Poo
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields lineup announcement and festival program
occurrences.quote_span: Daisy Chain Fields united a women-led lineup boasting queer pop star Chappell Roan, breakout rapper Doechii and riot grrrl pioneers Bikini Kill behind issues of women’s health, workplace protections and legal rights.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields festival activities and partner-booth records
occurrences.quote_span: Festivalgoers can collect pins from each booth as they learn about health services from Planned Parenthood’s local partners or pay tribute to caregivers through the National Domestic Workers Alliance.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Olivia Rodrigo biography and birth records
occurrences.quote_span: Rodrigo, 23, has made a name channeling the rage and dissatisfaction of modern romance into chart-topping songs that are equal parts Taylor Swift and Alanis Morissette.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Benefit-concert fundraising records and charitable-disbursement records
occurrences.quote_span: All-star benefit concerts have long been popular for driving millions of dollars toward everything from refugee aid and famine relief to pandemic response and natural disasters.

occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Lilith Fair history and Daisy Chain Fields guest listing
occurrences.quote_span: Sarah McLachlan, who founded the show to dispel the music industry’s notion they couldn’t book women consecutively, is listed as a special guest of Daisy Chain Fields.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Benefit-concert performance agreements and historical concert records

occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Planned Parenthood concert-outreach program records
occurrences.quote_span: Concert outreach has long been an important tool to reach people “where they are,” she said.
occurrences.speaker: Caren Spruch
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields event footage and AP photo records
occurrences.quote_span: Olivia Rodrigo, left, introduces special guest Sarah McLachlan to the audience at the Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival on Saturday, Aug. 29, 2026, at Great Park in Irvine, Calif.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields grant agreements and nonprofit financial records
occurrences.quote_span: Charitable partners applauded the grants for general operating support — meaning the nonprofits decide how to spend the money.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Pivotal Ventures pledge announcement and Daisy Chain Fields event footage
occurrences.quote_span: Philanthropist Melinda French Gates pledged another $10 million through her Pivotal Ventures in a surprise appearance at the start of Rodrigo’s set, calling her “a force” and praising her for “showing a new generation how much their voices matter.”
occurrences.speaker: Melinda French Gates
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields donation announcement and nonprofit grant records
occurrences.quote_span: Ahead of Saturday’s festival in Irvine, California, Rodrigo announced the show had already raised enough to make a $10 million donation to 10 nonprofit partners including Planned Parenthood, National Women’s Law Center and Black Mamas Matter Alliance.
occurrences.speaker: Olivia Rodrigo
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: National Women's Law Center grant records and litigation docket
occurrences.quote_span: For the National Women’s Law Center, the gift offers flexibility to plug their own budgetary holes as they litigate sex discrimination cases.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields lineup and festival audience records
occurrences.quote_span: The lineup seemed intentionally curated to attract multiple generations, she said.
occurrences.speaker: Melissa Shaw
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. administration grant suspension and restoration records
occurrences.quote_span: His administration paused $27.5 million last year for such organizations, including some Planned Parenthood affiliates, before officials agreed to restore the money.

occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: State abortion-clinic records, court filings and abortion-medication access records
